name: recued
description: Connects Gemini CLI to your own Recued server over MCP: read your notes, tasks and the things you own, and propose changes that wait for your approval in Recued.

settings.name: Recued MCP address
settings.description: The address the contract's Connect tab shows. On the computer Recued runs on: http://127.0.0.1:7717/mcp

settings.name: Recued contract key
settings.description: The key of a contract you make for Gemini CLI in the Recued web app, under Contracts.
